BiblicalUsage: The name is Salmai, an Israelite. You find the name in Ezra 2:46, "The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai…", and again in Nehemiah 7:48.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Salmai counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
